paragraphs: Ulpana. Chapter Haddar 67, end of a: Rabbi Chanin bar Ammi said in Ulpana’s name. It would appear to be a sage’s name, or mean what elsewhere is “in the name of received teaching.” Rashi, however, explains: he heard from his master, who heard from his master. Arakhin 28b: Rabbi Chiyya bar Ammi said in Chulfana’s name—it should read Ulpana, as in the new Talmud editions’ variants.
